book.name: 1 CORINTIOS
book.title: U BꞌAXA Uꞌ ITZꞌIBꞌA BꞌEN U PABLO XEꞌ QꞌU NIMAN TETZ U JESUUSTU CORINTO U bꞌaxa uꞌuj uvaꞌ itzꞌibꞌa bꞌen u Pablo te unqꞌa aa Corinto uvaꞌ ni niman u Jesús

content: As eteesataj etexhlabꞌal tiꞌ uveꞌ nunbꞌaneꞌ, tan aꞌ ni veesakat vexhlabꞌal tiꞌ u Cristo.
Ni tal u Pablo uvaꞌ kam itxumbꞌal unqꞌa ixojeꞌ la ibꞌan tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh
Vitzꞌin vatzik, ni voksa eqꞌii, tan bꞌenameen netulsa in sekꞌuꞌl. As nenima unqꞌa chusbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ kat unchus sete. As yeꞌxhkam nejalpu isuuchil.
U Tiixheꞌ aꞌeꞌ ibꞌooqꞌol u Cristoeꞌ, as u Cristoeꞌ aꞌeꞌ ibꞌooqꞌol u najeꞌ, as u najeꞌ aꞌeꞌ ibꞌooqꞌol u ixojeꞌ.
Asoj la ibꞌaju umaj naj iviꞌ tul uvaꞌ ninach naj Tiixh tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh moj la tal naj umaj yol uveꞌ aꞌ tzaanajkat xeꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, as la teesa najeꞌ iqꞌii u Cristo.

Pet ech koj u ixojeꞌ tan asoj yeꞌl iviꞌ ixoj la ibꞌaju tul uvaꞌ ninach ixoj Tiixh pet moj tul la tal ixoj umaj yol uvaꞌ aꞌ tzaanajkat xeꞌ u Tiixheꞌ, as la teesa ixoj iqꞌii vitzumeleꞌ, tan eela kuxh stukꞌ uvaꞌ kat tzokꞌpik el u xiꞌl iviꞌ ixojeꞌ.
Tan asoj yeꞌ la ibꞌaju ixoj viviꞌeꞌ, as aal bꞌaꞌneꞌ uvaꞌ la tzokꞌpik el u xiꞌl iviꞌ ixojeꞌ. Pet asoj chꞌixubꞌal te ixoj uvaꞌ la tzokꞌpu veꞌt u xiꞌl iviꞌ ixojeꞌ, as ibꞌaju ixoj viviꞌeꞌ.
As yeꞌ la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ la ibꞌaju u najeꞌ viviꞌeꞌ tan ivatzibꞌal u Tiixheꞌ u najeꞌ. Tan ni toksa naj iqꞌii u Tiixheꞌ. Pet ech koj u ixojeꞌ, tan aꞌ vitzumel ixojeꞌ la toksa iqꞌii.
Tan tul uvaꞌ kat icheesa veꞌt u Tiixheꞌ u bꞌaxa najeꞌ tukꞌ u bꞌaxa ixojeꞌ, as yeꞌle uvaꞌ aꞌ koj kat elkat chꞌuꞌl u najeꞌ kꞌatz u ixojeꞌ. Pet aꞌ kat elkat chꞌuꞌl u ixojeꞌ kꞌatz u najeꞌ.
As yeꞌ kat icheesa u Tiixheꞌ u najeꞌ tiꞌ ilochat u ixojeꞌ. Pet kat icheesa Aak u ixojeꞌ tiꞌ ilochat u najeꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ techal chit la ibꞌaju u ixojeꞌ viviꞌeꞌ texhlal tetz uvaꞌ ninima veꞌt ixoj vitzumeleꞌ, tan aꞌeꞌ bꞌaꞌn vatz unqꞌa ángel.
Pet sukuvatz, jankꞌal oꞌ uvaꞌ at veꞌt ok oꞌ kꞌatz u Kubꞌaal Jesúseꞌ, as yeꞌl koj u najeꞌ, as yeꞌle u ixojeꞌ ati. As yeꞌl koj u ixojeꞌ, as yeꞌle u najeꞌ ati,
Echeꞌ taꞌ u ixojeꞌ tan u Tiixheꞌ taꞌ kat cheesan ixoj taꞌn vimelekꞌ
u najeꞌ. As u najeꞌ aꞌ ni titzꞌebꞌ kat naj kꞌatz u ixojeꞌ. As kajayil kuxheꞌ taꞌ tzaanaj xeꞌ u Tiixheꞌ.
As qitzꞌataj setukꞌ, ¿ma bꞌaꞌn kuxhtuꞌ uvaꞌ la inach veꞌt unqꞌa ixojeꞌ Tiixh tu u atinbꞌaleꞌ tetz nachbꞌal Tiixh, as tul yeꞌl viviꞌ chaꞌmaeꞌ bꞌajumal?
As chiannal veꞌt sqe uvaꞌ nitzokꞌpik el u xiꞌl iviꞌ unqꞌa najeꞌ, tan chꞌixubꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ yeꞌ la tzokꞌpik el u xiꞌl iviꞌ u najeꞌ.
Pet ech koj u ixojeꞌ, tan tetz chit ixojeꞌ uvaꞌ la ichꞌiisa ixoj u xiꞌl iviꞌeꞌ. Tan aꞌ u Tiixheꞌ kat aqꞌon te ixoj uvaꞌ nim u xiꞌl iviꞌ ixojeꞌ, tan aꞌ u xiꞌl iviꞌ ixojeꞌ ni bꞌajun viviꞌ ixojeꞌ.
Asoj abꞌil yeꞌ la niman u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni valeꞌ, as la val sete uvaꞌ chiannal sqe uvaꞌ ech chit nu kubꞌaneꞌ. As echat nibꞌan unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ tulaj unjoltu unqꞌa tenameꞌ.
Ni paasa tibꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ tiꞌ u txꞌaꞌoꞌm uvaꞌ ijej kan u Jesúseꞌ
As tuk untzꞌibꞌa bꞌen kaꞌt unqꞌa yoleꞌ sete, vitzꞌin vatzik. Pet yeꞌ la uch valataꞌ uvaꞌ bꞌaꞌn nebꞌaneꞌ, tan jit u bꞌaꞌneꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ tul uvaꞌ nemol etibꞌ. Pet aꞌ u vaꞌlexheꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ,
tan kat vabꞌi yol setiꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ tul nemol etibꞌ sekajayil tiꞌ enachat Tiixh, as jit eela etxumbꞌal. Pet jalel tibꞌ vetxumbꞌaleꞌ. As nunnima unbꞌiil uvaꞌ an chit u yoleꞌ uveꞌ ni vabꞌi,
tan ni vitzꞌa uvaꞌ techal chit la ibꞌaneꞌ uvaꞌ jit eela vetxumbꞌaleꞌ tiꞌ uvaꞌ la ootzili uvaꞌ abꞌiste ex uveꞌ ex tetz u Tiixheꞌ.
Tan tul uvaꞌ nemol etibꞌ as echeꞌ tetzkoj u Jesús u txꞌaꞌoꞌmeꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ.
Tan tul uvaꞌ netxꞌaꞌneꞌ, as at ex uvaꞌ bꞌaxel netechbꞌu vetetzeꞌ vatz vemooleꞌ. Estiꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ at ex uveꞌ nu kuxh ekuy veꞌt evaꞌy. As tul at kaꞌt ex uveꞌ qꞌabꞌaꞌm nebꞌan veꞌteꞌ.

¿As yeꞌl kol ekabꞌal qꞌa ati uvaꞌ la txꞌaꞌnkat ex as la ukꞌaꞌkat ex? ¿As ma yeꞌ nibꞌen sete uvaꞌ ni teesa tibꞌ eqꞌii sevatzaj tiꞌ echꞌixvisat unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzikeꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌl tetz ati? As tul molomal ex sekajayil taꞌn u Tiixheꞌ. ¿Kam la val qꞌi tiꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ? ¿Ma netaleꞌ uvaꞌ la voksa eqꞌii stiꞌ? ¡Yeꞌle taꞌ!
Nichusun u Pablo tiꞌ umaꞌl u txꞌaꞌoꞌm uvaꞌ ijej kan u Jesús

As u chusbꞌaleꞌ uveꞌ kat unkꞌul taꞌn u Kubꞌaal Jesús, as aꞌeꞌ kat unchus sete. As ech ni tal ileꞌ: Tan tu u aqꞌbꞌaleꞌ uvaꞌ kat aqꞌax ok u Kubꞌaal Jesús tiqꞌabꞌ unqꞌa iqꞌesal unqꞌa tenameꞌ as tul yeꞌxnik itxey chajnaj Aak, as itxey veꞌt Aak u paaneꞌ.

As tul maꞌt taqꞌat Aak taꞌntiixh stiꞌ, as ijatx veꞌt Aak u paaneꞌ. As ech tal veꞌt Aak ileꞌ: «Etxeytaj; as etxꞌaꞌtaj, tan aꞌeꞌ vunchiꞌoleꞌ uveꞌ tuk vaqꞌ kꞌaxbꞌisaloj setiꞌ. As chajpaj chit etxꞌaꞌat u paaneꞌ echeꞌ uvaꞌ nu kubꞌan cheel, as la etulsa in sekꞌuꞌl,» tiꞌk Aak.

As echat chit ibꞌan Aak tukꞌ u koopa tan tul uvaꞌ kat tzojpu veꞌt itxꞌaꞌn chajnaj, as itxey veꞌt Aak u koopa. As ech tal Aak ileꞌ: «As u aꞌeꞌ uvaꞌ at kuꞌ tu u koopa, as aꞌeꞌ u akꞌ tzaqꞌiteꞌ uveꞌ la kꞌujebꞌ kan taꞌn vunkajaleꞌ. As chajpaj chit etukꞌat u vino tu u koopa echeꞌ uvaꞌ nu kubꞌan cheel, as la etulsa in sekꞌuꞌl,» tiꞌk Aak.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, tan chajpaj chit etxꞌaꞌat u paaneꞌ as chajpaj chit etukꞌat u vino uveꞌ at tu u koopa, as aꞌ vikamebꞌal u Kubꞌaal Jesús la etulsa sekꞌuꞌl sevatzaj techal la ul Aak tikaꞌpa.
Ni taqꞌ u Pablo itxumbꞌal unqꞌa niman tetz u Jesús tiꞌ u txꞌaꞌoꞌm uvaꞌ ijej kan u Jesús

Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, abꞌil ex uvaꞌ la txꞌaꞌon u paaneꞌ as la etukꞌa u vino tu u koopa as tul yeꞌ bꞌaꞌn etatineꞌ sevatzaj, as ech exeꞌ echeꞌ unqꞌa uxhchileꞌ uvaꞌ kat eesan iqꞌii u Kubꞌaaleꞌ. Tul kat kꞌaxbꞌu vichiꞌol Aakeꞌ, as kat el vikajal Aakeꞌ vatz u kuruseꞌ.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val sete, etitzꞌataj jeꞌ etibꞌ sejununila. As aꞌn la etxꞌaꞌ u paaneꞌ. As la etukꞌa u vino uvaꞌ at tu u koopa.
Tan asoj la etxꞌaꞌ u paaneꞌ. As la etukꞌa u vino uvaꞌ at tu u koopa as tul yeꞌ kat etitzꞌa jeꞌ etibꞌ sevatzaj, as aꞌ u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ la eteqꞌo tzan setiꞌ.
As nimal unqꞌa qitzꞌin qatzik at sexoꞌl uvaꞌ aachꞌoꞌm. As ati uvaꞌ yaabꞌ kuxh vichiꞌoleꞌ. As ati uvaꞌ kamnalu veꞌteꞌ.
As kat koj qitzꞌa jeꞌ qibꞌ, as yeꞌ la bꞌanchu kusuuchil taꞌn u Kubꞌaaleꞌ.
Pet tul nibꞌan u Kubꞌaaleꞌ kusuuchil, as nu kupalebꞌe u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ taꞌn Aak, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la bꞌen oꞌ tu u choobꞌal paaveꞌ tukꞌ unqꞌa tenameꞌ uveꞌ yeꞌ ni niman Aak.
Estiꞌeꞌ ni val veꞌt sete, vitzꞌin vatzik, tul uvaꞌ la emol etibꞌ tiꞌ u txꞌaꞌoꞌmeꞌ, as etxꞌebꞌtaj etibꞌ sekajayil tiꞌ etxꞌaꞌneꞌ.

Asoj at ex uvaꞌ vaꞌy ni bꞌanon ex, as txꞌaꞌnoj ex tekabꞌal, aqꞌal uvaꞌ yeꞌ la ul u kꞌaxkꞌoeꞌ setiꞌ tiꞌ u vaꞌlexheꞌ uveꞌ nebꞌaneꞌ tul nemol etibꞌ sevatzaj. Atil chit kaꞌt u yol uveꞌ la vil isuuchil. As oonnal veꞌt in sexoꞌl unpajte.
